candidates.name: Sturge-Weber syndrome
support_spans: bilateral naevus flammeus along the ophthalmic and maxillary divisions of the trigeminal nerve
iris heterochromia with diffuse hyperpigmentation and evenly distributed micronodular elevations on the iris surface
contradict_spans: MRI of the brain showed no leptomeningeal vascular malformations
candidates.why: The presence of naevus flammeus and iris heterochromia are characteristic features of Sturge-Weber syndrome.

candidates.name: Ocular melanocytosis
support_spans: iris heterochromia with diffuse hyperpigmentation

candidates.why: The presence of iris heterochromia and diffuse trabecular hyperpigmentation are consistent with ocular melanocytosis.

candidates.name: Glaucoma
support_spans: intraocular pressure measured by Icare tonometry was 22 mm Hg in the right eye

candidates.why: The elevated intraocular pressure and response to topical latanoprost suggest glaucoma.
